verdict.rationale: smolagents explicitly adopts OpenTelemetry for instrumenting agent runs, enabling tracing of LLM calls and tool invocations in observability UIs (e.g. via OTel-compatible backends), and also offers agent.replay() and memory access for step-by-step inspection. missing for 10: no first-party screenshots/hands-on walkthrough of a specific observability UI (e.g. Langfuse/Phoenix) integration, and no independent corroboration of trace completeness in practice.
